name: AWS SaaS Boost — Tenant Service
description: Hand-authored CALM gold for awslabs/aws-saas-boost tenant-service: API Gateway–backed Lambda (RequestHandler) for /tenants CRUD and enable/disable, DynamoDB-backed DAL. Independent of the platform generator. Evidence: TenantService.java, TenantServiceDAL.java, saas-boost-public-api.yaml PathPart tenants, saas-boost-svc-tenant.yaml Handler method bindings.

metadata.value: TenantService Lambda handler + TenantServiceDAL Dynamo store; API paths from public API Gateway template; method handlers from saas-boost-svc-tenant.yaml
Other SaaS Boost services; EventBridge side-effects as first-class nodes; Cognito; onboarding CFN; admin React client; tenant_update_event.py

HTTP surface is API Gateway + Lambda method handlers (RequestHandler + APIGatewayProxyResponseEvent). Persistence is AWS SDK v2 DynamoDbClient on TenantServiceDAL only (handler does not import Dynamo client — cleaner ontology case than tier-service).
WDL-1 Lambda; WDL-2 Dynamo ownership (disconfirming: handler must stay service even if DAL is database)
